digest.component_or_area: RP-04 secrets and authentication architecture research
propositions: Research phase complete; credential boundaries, provider mechanisms, and OSS prior art inventoried across all named providers (Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gerrit, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Jira Cloud/DC) and environments (local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS-hosted, CLI, library, MCP)
Rebar must delegate authentication/refresh/rotation to official SDKs and helpers; it owns only safe typed injection, fail-closed provider selection, and exclusion from snapshots/caches/logs

Static credentials use Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes only in provider-specific non-serializable containers; operation snapshots structurally cannot contain wrapped secrets; unwrapping occurs only inside the sending adapter

Trusted same-capability children inherit ambient environment; Rebar-materialized static credentials overlay only onto owning child; unrelated siblings remove exact declared secret variable names; no global os.environ mutation

Long-running processes restart to obtain rotated static credentials; native temporary credentials remain SDK-owned and may refresh in-process; revoked old credentials fail as authentication errors without fallback

Initial Python seam accepts provider-native auth capabilities (boto3 Session, Anthropic AccessTokenProvider, OpenAI identity providers) into Rebar factories; does not accept arbitrary fully-constructed clients that bypass Rebar policy
